title: File and Diagonal
setup: The h-file stands open in front of the black king, and its rook has just stepped to e8.
hint: Your queen wants one square where a file and a diagonal each end on a black piece.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qh5+}} checks down the open h-file, and on the other line it looks through g6 and f7 straight at the rook. The pawn on g7 leaves Black only {{Kg8}}, and {{Qxe8+}} takes the rook with check. A queen forks because it is a rook and a bishop at once.
